title: Liquid flow measurement in open channels - Velocity area methods - collection and processing of data for determination of errors in measurement
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 14573) covers Liquid flow measurement in open channels - Velocity area methods - collection and processing of data for determination of errors in measurement. This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 1088 : 1985 'Liquid flow measurement in open channels — Velocity-area methods — Collection and processing of data for determination of errors in measurement' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the of the River Valley Division Council. Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard' . Comma ( , ) has been used as a decimal marker, while in Indian Standard, the current practice is to use a point ( . ) as the decimal marker. CROSS REFERENCES In this standard the following International Standards are referred to. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
